basic_info.description: Gorgeous & Exceptional Home in Desirable Central Parkside with Breathtaking Ocean Views from Rear Deck! This fully renovated, 2-level home, spanning 1,973 SQFT living space, 3,000 SQFT lot, offers 3BD/2.5BA. Fully remodeled from studs, new electrical, new plumbing, multi-zone radiant floor heating throughout the whole house, all done with permits. Behind its modern facade, youll find luxury SPC hardwood floors, recessed lighting, abundance of natural light that flows seamlessly through the homes, enhanced opening sliding doors to the rear deck & backyard. Upper level boasts a dramatic chefs kitchen with premium finishes, quartz countertops, elegant backsplash, S/S appliances, and sleek modern cabinetry, formal dining room, sunroom, and 2BD/1.5BA. Lower level features spacious family room with kitchenette (Permitted), office, plus 3rd bedroom, full baths, & spacious backyard with patio. Washer/dryer installed ready, 1-car garage, tankless water heater, radiant heating system, EV changing port, and driveway parking. Conveniently located near public transportation, top-ranked schools, park, restaurants, & shops. Must See!
